description: It is happening there, and everyone is going. Aso ebi so the family is visibly one family, gele that took someone forty minutes, jollof that will be judged, and money sprayed over the dancers because prosperity is meant to be seen.
energy_note: The day everyone cleared the calendar for.

description: The weeks before an owambe are their own good thing. Kumar, Killingsworth and Gilovich found anticipation of an experience is pleasurable in itself and, notably, unrelated to what it cost.
energy_note: The waiting is part of the thing, not a delay before it.
notes: Waiting for Merlot: anticipatory consumption of experiential and material purchases.

description: The function of a marked day is that it makes attendance compulsory in a way ordinary invitations do not. That is why it produces the relationships the longitudinal research keeps identifying as decisive.
Money, a venue, food for a number of people nobody has counted, and everyone being free on the same date.
energy_note: Everyone in one place on one date, which is the hard part.
notes: Where family is split across borders or permit regimes, this is the row that breaks. See FAM categories in assets/text/{palestine,iran}.

description: An owambe stops being an event and becomes a reference point - retold, compared against, and eventually shorthand inside one family for a whole kind of day.
energy_note: It turns into the story about it.
notes: Experiential purchases retain value through memory where material ones decay; people are markedly unwilling to trade the memory away.

description: Taken badly, kept forever, and produced at the next one of these. Every marked day is partly an appointment to generate the images that will be shown at a later marked day.
energy_note: Documentation, for use in about thirty years.
